chunks: And from him, from Ṣafwān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, from Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
“It is not upon the female slaves to cover themselves with a head-cover in salat, and it is not proper for a woman to perform salat except in two garments.”

key_terms.يَتَقَنَّعْنَ: to cover themselves with a head-cover or veil

ai.seo_question: What clothing is required for women and female slaves in salat according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning dress in salat for women and female slaves. It distinguishes between the obligation of head-covering for female slaves and the recommended or required standard of a woman praying in two garments.
